## Try the block editor

The [interactive block editor](editor/index.html) builds Reactive Robot DSL visually. Drag blocks, inspect the generated code, copy it onto a machine running the controller, and press F5 in the curses sequence editor to execute.

## What is Reactive Robot?

Reactive Robot drives a Braccio V2 servo arm through a continuous base sweep from 0° to 180° and back, detecting and avoiding obstacles in real time. Four VL53L5CX 8x8 time-of-flight grids, four IR proximity sensors, and an MPU-6050 IMU fuse into a world-frame point cloud. Every motion request routes through `SafetyAPI.plan_and_validate` before the servos receive a signal.

The codebase ships three integrated surfaces:

1. A curses controller (`python -m braccio_ctrl`) for live operation on real hardware.
2. A PyBullet digital twin (`python -m braccio_twin`) that runs the same safety stack against virtual sensors.
3. A FastAPI backend + React + Blockly frontend for browser-based programming.
